properties.name: Csörge-tó
properties.approximationNote: Coarse low-confidence Csörge-tó neighbourhood envelope including the literal lake, adjoining Nyámándpuszta-side land and the eastern Bogyiszlói út approach, so address matching is not restricted to water. The western edge retains actual Bogyiszlói út vertices near the Galamb utca junction; the eastern approach retains literal Bogyiszlói út road vertices, while Sárközi-összekötőcsatorna turns constrain the north/east/south setting. Joins across adjoining garden/field land are manually inferred. The boundary is not official, parcel-accurate or independently validated; overlaps with neighbouring industrial/rural areas are intentional. No circle, distance buffer or point-only rectangle was used. The earlier literal-lake polygon remains a source alternative.
